regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, non-directional rotation in Hong Kong with only 4 of 17 themes eligible under the absolute-trend gate. Banks lead on score but are crowded with mixed Hurst; Energy is the only other large positive score with clean trend tag. The validated absolute-trend gate did help historically in HK (gate_helps=true), but the momentum/rotation legs have no forward edge, so this is pure discipline-over-prediction territory. Almost every theme is unscorable (no ETF proxy), which forces near-zero conviction on most names.
emerging_watch: Watching whether High-Dividend Blue Chips (hk_dividend) upgrades its trend signals: it is eligible with a clean trend tag (hurst=trend, breadth 0.75) and decent durability (0.68) but a modest score (0.92). If its score rises above ~1.3 while Energy's durability bar dips below 0.75, that observable shift would retire this watch as a confirmed handoff toward income/defensive leadership in HK.

theses.thesis: Energy is the only eligible theme with both a strong positive score (1.165) and a clean trend tag with high durability (0.80) and broad internal participation (breadth 0.80). It is not crowded, so there is no sizing caution on top of eligibility. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated leg in this market, and Energy passes it with best-in-class trend health among eligible names.

This is an avoid-not-fade call, never a short.
